name: Cangzhou
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: Historically -5 to -10 cm/yr (>2 m cumulative since 1970), moderating to ~-2 to -4 cm/yr after pumping restrictions and South-to-North Water Diversion (Zhang et al., 2014)
literature_sources: Zhang, Y. et al. (2014), Environmental Earth Sciences, https://doi.org/10.1007/s12665-013-2532-7
agreement_note: Consistent: 120-day summer NISAR peak (-2.4 cm LOS, -3.2 cm vertical est., -2.0 cm/100d) aligns with moderated modern -2 to -4 cm/yr rates in Cangzhou. Tight reference sensitivity [-2.4, -1.6] cm (ratio 0.33), 43.2% valid pixels.
press_summary_gate_note: Reliable #7 in ATLAS v2 common-window ranking (-2.0 cm/100d, 43.2% valid, ref ratio 0.33); pending PC5 final review.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
